span.normalized: The Corporation also announced negotiations with an established third-party anode manufacturer toward the opportunity of securing up to 30 ktpy of graphite concentrate from the Matawinie Mine, including an expected take-or-pay commitment, to potentially support the active anode material needs of GM and other customers. In connection with these negotiations, the Corporation and GM have agreed to terminate their previously announced supply agreement and subscription agreement, each dated February 14, 2024, such terminations to be effective November 30, 2025.
